params.linkText: started the Blackstone Private Markets Fund

children: , or BXPM, a new perpetual flagship strategy providing simplified access to the firm's private markets platform in a single allocation, the company said Thursday.
The fund marks the first time eligible non-U.S. investors have access to Blackstone's
institutional-quality perpetual funds through a single product, providing private market exposure across four core assets.
$364B private equity strategies, including corporate private equity, tactical opportunities, growth, and life sciences, and secondaries business;
Private infrastructure, through Blackstone's $90B infrastructure business that invests across energy, transportation, and digital infrastructure;
Private real estate, through the firm's $314B real estate business, the largest owner of commercial real estate globally; and
Credit, through the company's $469B credit and insurance business spanning global credit markets.

"We have thoughtfully designed BXPM to enable investors to access private equity, infrastructure, real estate, and private credit in a single intentionally constructed portfolio – essentially, it’s private markets simplified by Blackstone," said Rashmi Madan, global head of Portfolio Solutions and CEO of BXPM.
Like most alternative asset managers, Blackstone

stock dipped, down 2.5% in midday trading, as increased expectations for Fed rate hikes pressure the sector. Higher interest rates tend to inhibit M&A and initial public offering activity, key avenues for private equity firms to exit their investments.

title: Blackstone launches BXPM fund to simplify access to private markets
